label: Dungeons & Dragons
tagline: Bend time itself to gather your party.
deleteConfirmPost: Its sessions, availability and votes are lost for good, and its Discord events are removed. This cannot be undone.
hoursChosenBy: The Dungeon Master chose these hours in
cancelPollConfirm: Cancel this poll? Players will no longer be able to respond.
botPollCreated: A new scroll is unfurled for **{title}**. Run `/schedule` or open it here: {url}
botVoteBody: The scroll is sealed and the stars have spoken. Cast your vote below. Times appear in your own timezone.
botVoteClosed: Voting has ended for this scroll.
botPollClosed: The scroll is sealed. The vote will appear in this channel shortly.
botPollDecreed: The session is decreed. Watch this channel for the announcement.
botPollCancelled: This scroll was burned. The {organizer} may unfurl a new one.
botNeedManage: You need the Manage Channels or Manage Server permission to bind a campaign to this channel.
notMember: You are not part of this party yet. In Discord, run /schedule in the campaign's channel to join, then reload this page.
notLinked: This campaign is not tied to a Discord channel, so votes and announcements will not be posted there. In the channel, run `/chronomancer setup` and paste this into its `code` option:
frequency: How often does the party gather?
freq_monthly: Every month, on the same weekday (like the 4th Saturday)
botSessionCancelled: The gathering planned for {when} is cancelled. Await word of a new date.
botRemindersAt: The party will be reminded at: {times}.
botRemindersNoFit: No reminder fits before the session, for it comes sooner than your reminder times. Change them with `/chronomancer setup`.
botRecurredBody: The next gathering is set at the same hour: **{title}** begins {when}.
botRecurrenceNote: When it ends, the next gathering is set automatically for {when}.
botRsvpInAck: Noted: you will be there. You can change your answer until the gathering begins.
botRsvpOutAck: Noted: you cannot make it ({out} of {active} so far). You can change your answer until the gathering begins.
botRsvpCalledOff: Noted, and with that more than half the party cannot come. The gathering is called off and a new poll is open in the channel.
botRsvpClosed: That gathering is no longer upcoming, so your answer was not recorded.
botRsvpStranger: You are not part of this party.
botRescheduleBody: More than half the party cannot make **{title}**{when}, so it is called off. Mark when you are free for the coming week: {url}
events: Raise a Discord event for each gathering
gridHint: Click (or tap) a box once for available, twice for maybe, three times for not available. One more click clears it. Click a day or a time to fill a whole column or row.
